title: AIで画像の代替テキストを作る｜用途と周りの文章を渡す確認メモ
intent: Web担当者が画像の用途と掲載文脈をAIへ渡し、代替テキスト案を人が判断する具体的な作業。
sections: 画像の見た目より、ページでの役割を確認する
コピーして使う4つの欄
同じ椅子の写真を、二つの場所で使う例
実際のページと照らして仕上げる
worksheet: 画像の役割・伝えたいこと
近くの文章・リンク先
AIの案と人の採否・理由
example: Clearly labeled fictional chair example; describe only observable confirmed attributes. Decorative use may use empty alt when appropriate. Do not infer material, comfort or durability from an image.
overlapReview: All20article titles/sections checked by agent. Launch checklist mentions finalized images but not purpose-based alt decisions, request fields or a worked example. Separate from brief/change-request/fact-check tasks.
requirements: Recheck W3C primary guidance before publication; latest-model subagent full draft and root fact review.
No accessibility-compliance, SEO-ranking or productivity guarantees; fictional example must not be described as actual customer outcome.
No public reference list or internal planning metadata.
New page package plus normal listing/sitemap only; record shared listing confound, preserve existing article/source freezes.

deferredProcedureRoute.reason: Same source observes time-sheet link; existing ChatGPT link already covers route.
